benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Fitness studios on Meta average $18–$35 per lead, with optimized campaigns hitting $15–$22. Boutique and personal training sit higher at $32–$52. Fitness converts at 14.29% on Meta — the highest of any industry.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: November is when committed prospects start planning January goals. Black Friday and year-end transformation offers drive sign-ups. Lead costs rise sharply into January, so locking in leads now is cheaper than waiting.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Studios lean into community and video
competitor.body: Boutique studios are winning with short-form video, referrals, and value-led trial offers over discounts. Cancellations at studios fell 6% versus big-box gyms. Member-filmed content outperforms polished studio production on lead cost.

recommendations.title: Check why latest-day spend dropped to $3.85
recommendations.detail: Confirm whether the pullback is intentional, budget-capped, or a delivery issue. A paused campaign heading into Black Friday forfeits the cheapest leads of the quarter.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and CRM data before scaling further
recommendations.detail: Without lead counts and trial-to-member rates, spend decisions are blind. Worth wiring up form submissions and pipeline stages this week to measure cost per lead against the $18–$35 benchmark.

recommendations.title: Test a Black Friday trial offer for PCOS and postpartum audience
recommendations.detail: Consider a value-led intro pack (not a discount) timed for late November. Short-form member video outperforms polished creative on lead cost for boutique studios.
